classification.difficultyReason: Convert light years to kilometres using time-unit conversion and multiplication in scientific notation.

content.prompt: The furthest galaxy detected by optical telescopes is approximately $4.6\times10^9$ light years from us. How far is this in kilometres? (Light travels at $3\times10^5\text{ km/s}$.) Use 365 days per year and give your answer in scientific notation with the coefficient rounded to 2 decimal places.

answer.worked:
Using 365 days per year:
$$\begin{align*}t&=(4.6\times10^9)\times365\times24\times60\times60\text{ s}\\t&=1.450656\times10^{17}\text{ s}\\d&=(3\times10^5)(1.450656\times10^{17})\text{ km}\\d&=4.351968\times10^{22}\text{ km}\\d&\approx4.35\times10^{22}\text{ km}\end{align*}$$
